predictions: Hey! I surpassed my four weeks of 17-8 records! I got all the way up to… 18-7 last week. Ha! Well, one better is one better. And among those 7 losses were a shorthanded 11-10, three 13-11s, a 14-10, and a 14-9. Man, I was so close to so much more… That brings me to 86-39 968.8% correct) through five weeks, which isn't too bad, I suppose. But what is bad? My 0-4 record in Cheap Shots matches! 0 for 4!

Match of the week: (A Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ The Hunted Element. The last two undefeated teams in A tangle here. If Show Me wins, they could conceivably have a two-match lead at the turn. If Element wins, it's entirely possible that they then fall to Jonesing next week and the A race would be a near start-over for the second half. Show Me is super deep, but I just have to take my guys, 13-11.

Match #2: (G Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Death Throw. Hello! The only other remaining all-undefeated match this season (along with the one above) will be deciding the G leader. Machine finally got really pushed last week, but other than that, these two have been dominant. Maybe this is because Machine torpedoed me last fall… DT, 13-11.

Match #3: (C Div.) Bottoms Up @ OnlyDarts. Oh man, OnlyDarts got just swamped early by Sanchez last week. If they hadn't, this would be yet another double-undefeated pairing. OnlyDarts is really talented, but I just still have the full-on ladder-climb feeling with the Bottoms, 14-10.

Match #4: (D Div.) Area 501 @ Menace 2 Sobriety. Oh, sadness… Menace shorthanded themselves right into a loss where they won more than half the slots last week, and now this isn't a battle of unbeatens. I feel like Area is the class of D still, but the gap is narrower. Area, 14-10.

Match #5: (B Div.) Hump Day! @ Darty Minds. Hump Day just lives on the 13-11 edge, man… 3 in a row. Darty, on the other hand, has been all over the place (big win, tight win, loss, penalty). 13-11, but it's Darty.
Match #6: (F Div.) Rippin Darts @ Runs with Corks. The Corks have already opened a 2-match lead in F, and here one of those chase teams get a chance to narrow the gap. Corks knock one back, 15-9.
Match #7: (H Div.) In the Wind, Dude! @ Flight Club. In The Wind is one week 2 slip from being in the H undefeated talk. But Flight Club has been looking similar. This will be tight. Wind, 13-11.

Match #8: (G Div.) Nein Mark @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. We Throw It has been hot so far, and sits just one match off the G lead. Nein has been oh so close so far too though, and I'll say Nein, 13-11.
Match #9: (E Div.) That's What She Said @ D's Bad News Bears. There is a four-pack of two-loss teams set to fight for the 2nd spot behind Point of Attack here. Let's go with Bad News in a tiebreaker.

Match #10: (A Div.) Dart Attack @ Wing & a Plaque. Depending on how the two Element matches come out in the next two weeks, Attack could be fighting for the league's #3 spot. Or the #4 spot. Or could it really be for the #2 spot? Attack takes this one, 15-9.
Match #11: (F Div.) Heart of Dartness @ Cheap Shots. All but one F team has 2 or 3 losses. Is this a fight for a top two spot? Or one to avoid a bottom two spot? Well…. yes… both. Dartness, 13-11.

Match #12: (D Div.) Rif Raf @ Nine Lives. I'm mostly picking this match because I really just can't believe both these teams are under 0.500. Despite Rif Raf tanking me last week, I'm with them, 14-10.
